decision_rules.action: Call farm_status to assess farm-wide health before profile-specific actions

requires.name: farm_status
requires.purpose: Get overall farm posture and per-farm health metrics

decision_rules.action: Call farm_profiles to see all profile states and identify conflicts
decision_rules.condition: farm_status shows farm healthy but start failed

requires.name: farm_profiles
requires.purpose: List all farm profiles with stripped secrets to inspect states

decision_rules.action: Call farm_profile_stop on target profile, then retry start after 2 second delay
decision_rules.condition: Target profile shows 'running', 'starting', or 'paused' in farm_profiles

requires.name: farm_profile_stop
requires.purpose: Gracefully stop a farm profile before restart attempt

decision_rules.action: Call farm_state_get to read coordination flags and container mappings

requires.name: farm_state_get
requires.purpose: Read farm shared state for coordination flags and container mappings

decision_rules.action: Call farm_profile on target profile for detailed state

requires.name: farm_profile
requires.purpose: Get detailed single farm profile state

decision_rules.action: Use farm_state_set to write recovery coordination flags preventing concurrent starts
decision_rules.condition: Multiple profiles need sequential restart after farm-wide issue

requires.name: farm_state_set
requires.purpose: Write farm shared state for recovery coordination

decision_rules.action: use farm_state_get, farm_profile, farm_state_set, and farm_profile_start in sequence
decision_rules.condition: farm status and state indicate the profile is stopped or idle and no container or registry error is present

decision_rules.action: require the container-registry capability before attempting further farm profile start
decision_rules.condition: the failure involves container image pull, registry authentication, or a missing container-registry capability

description: Methodology for diagnosing and recovering from farm_profile_start failures using only registered farm MCP tools. Handles HTTP errors, container issues, and profile state conflicts.

heuristics.description: Call farm_status to check overall farm health, then farm_profiles to list all profiles and their states
heuristics.name: farm_profile_start returns HTTP error or '[object Object]' response
heuristics.when_to_apply: farm_profile_start returns HTTP error or '[object Object]' response

heuristics.description: Call farm_profile_stop on that profile, wait 2s, then retry farm_profile_start
heuristics.name: target profile shows 'running' or 'starting' in farm_profiles but start failed
heuristics.when_to_apply: target profile shows 'running' or 'starting' in farm_profiles but start failed

heuristics.description: Check farm_state_get for coordination flags, then restart affected profiles sequentially with 3s delays
heuristics.name: farm_status shows farm posture degraded or containers unhealthy
heuristics.when_to_apply: farm_status shows farm posture degraded or containers unhealthy

heuristics.description: Use farm_state_get to read container mapping, then farm_command to issue container-specific recovery if supported
heuristics.name: error mentions 'container 3644' or specific container ID
heuristics.when_to_apply: error mentions 'container 3644' or specific container ID

heuristics.description: avoid blind retries; route to the container-registry capability if it is not available
heuristics.name: the error suggests a container, registry, or image pull problem
heuristics.when_to_apply: the error suggests a container, registry, or image pull problem

name: farm-profile-start-failure-recovery

principles.rationale: Always check farm status and profile state before attempting recovery actions to avoid compounding errors.
Determine if failure is profile-specific, farm-wide, or infrastructure-related by checking multiple profiles and system health.
Leverage farm_state_get/set to coordinate recovery across containers and avoid race conditions during re-expansion.
When profile is in unknown state, stop gracefully before restart rather than forcing start on potentially corrupted state.
